correctness_confidence.basis: Every theorem, proof, inequality, and numerical constant in the manuscript was verified directly. In particular, the 15-regularity and independence number alpha(G_2(P_24)) = 3, the 8-direction integer illumination partition of all 24 vertices of P_24 with margin <= -1 on all 6 active facets per vertex, the 4-vector LP cancellation proving lambda_8(P_24) >= 3/4, the Voronoi weak-duality formulation for lambda_8(P_24) <= 8/9, the universal d-dimensional covering ratios for Delta_d, beta_d, and C_d, the factor-d threshold collapse 2/d on -delta/2 Delta_d, the double-shadow.

rigor.basis: All continuum covering claims on P_24 are established via exact algebraic and LP-duality arguments over Q rather than heuristic sampling, supplemented by constructive Lean 4 theorems (reported with zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, and zero external imports) and zero-float rational certificates.

novelty.basis: Establishing c(P_24) = 8 and the explicit continuum interval [3/4, 8/9] for the self-dual 4D 24-cell, along with the clean 4-vector LP lower bound and the universal C_4 double-shadow obstruction / Hadamard H_4 elimination bound, provides genuinely new and timely higher-dimensional results following the 3D Hadwiger breakthrough [1]. The universal Delta_d, beta_d, and C_d covering ratios and Wallis mean-width recurrence are classical/elementary generalizations neatly unified with the 4D analysis.

significance.basis: Clarifies both the sharp 4D polytopal baseline (confirming all core regular 4-polytopes satisfy c(P) <= 16, with P_24 achieving 3x vertex compression c = 8) and two concrete structural obstacles preventing a direct verbatim lift of 3D shadow peeling into d >= 4.

reproducibility.basis: All witnesses, integer directions, LP dual structure, closed-form constructions, Lean 4 theorem identifiers (thm01-thm20), and canonical SHA-256 certificate indices (C01-C16) are explicitly specified in the manuscript.

summary: This paper investigates Hadwiger covering and illumination beyond three dimensions, delivering (1) the exact illumination number c(P_24) = 8 of the self-dual 4D 24-cell via alpha(G_2(P_24)) = 3 and an explicit centrally symmetric 4-pair integer illumination certificate; (2) exact continuum 8-homothet covering bounds 3/4 <= lambda_8(P_24) <= 8/9 via F_4-transitivity and a 4-vector LP cancellation for the lower bound and 576 exact rational Voronoi-cell LP duals (denominators in {1,2,3}) for the upper bound; (3) exact optimal minimal-cardinality covering ratios for Delta_d (d/(d+1)), beta_d ((d-1)/d), and C_d (1/2 closed, 2/3 explicit open-interior) for all d >= 2; and (4) two quantitative obstructions to extending 3D shadow peeling into d >= 4: a factor-d collapse from 2 to 2/d for the non-1D S-diameter covering threshold on -delta/2 Delta_d, and a universal double-shadow obstruction on C_4 retaining at least 4 square 2-faces (area >= 16) for every direction pair (w_1, w_2) in S^3 x S^3, generalized to k_min(d) = 1 + ceil(log_2 d) pairs on C_d alongside the John mean-width Wallis recurrence.
strengths: Self-contained, completely rigorous proof of c(P_24) = 8 with an explicit 8-direction integer certificate partitioning the 24 vertices into 8 disjoint triangular 2-faces with strict inward margin <= -1 on every active facet.
Elegant 3-line proof of lambda_8(P_24) >= 3/4 using F_4-transitivity on the 96 triangular 2-faces and an exact zero-sum combination of four facet normals canceling the translation center identically.
Non-sampling continuum proof of lambda_8(P_24) <= 8/9 over all of P_24 via exact rational Voronoi-cell LP weak duality with small denominators in {1, 2, 3}.
Sharp, transparent double-shadow pigeonhole argument showing every pair of directions in S^3 x S^3 leaves >= 4 complete 2-faces of C_4 unilluminated, while 3 Hadamard H_4 pairs eliminate all 2-faces.
Clean unification of the universal d-dimensional covering ratios for Delta_d, beta_d, and C_d and exact verification of the John mean-width Wallis recurrence.
weaknesses: The exact optimal 8-homothet covering ratio lambda_8(P_24) is bounded to [3/4, 8/9] rather than closed to a single exact optimum.

In Theorem 5.1, the test set A = -(delta/2) Delta_d is a full d-dimensional inverted simplex in R^d rather than a subset embedded inside a (d-2)-dimensional shadow boundary Sigma(Delta_d, w), and it already yields 2/3 < 2 in d = 3; hence the 2 vs. 2/d comparison contrasts [1]'s 1D-curve S-length bound against an unrestricted-dimension S-diameter bound (though the theorem statement and Figure 3(a) appropriately label it as the non-1D threshold).

In Theorem 5.2, the measure-1 double-shadow 2-face obstruction exploits flat (d-2)-faces of the non-smooth cube C_d (as acknowledged by the 'Non-Smooth' qualifier), and for d >= 5 eliminating all (d-2)-faces is necessary rather than sufficient to reduce Sigma to a 1D curve.
Table 1 and Section 6 reference Lean theorems thm19-thm20 and certificate C16 without explicitly stating their individual content in the main text (unlike thm01-thm18 and C01-C15).

Four-vector facet-sum cancellation lower bound for lambda_8(P_24) >= 3/4 exploiting F_4-transitivity on triangular 2-faces.
